title: Geometric components over residue fields of separably closed valued fields
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed, def-weil-field] and $V\subseteq K$ a valuation ring with fraction field $K$, meaning that for every $a\in K^\times$ either $a$ or $a^{-1}$ belongs to $V$. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset V$, the residue field $k=\operatorname{Frac}(V/\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is separably closed. Let $Z$ be a scheme of finite type over this $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] which is geometrically reduced, meaning that $Z_L=Z\times_k\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] for every field extension $L/k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Give each irreducible component $C$ of $Z$ its reduced induced closed-subscheme structure [def-weil-irreducible-components, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Then $C_L$ is integral (reduced and irreducible [def-pc-integral-scheme]) for every field extension $L/k$. For an algebraic closure $\overline k/k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], the assignment $C\mapsto C_{\overline k}$ is a bijection from the irreducible components of $Z$ to those of $Z_{\overline k}$, with their reduced induced structures. No finite-height assumption on $V$ is needed.

source.place: Tags 020J (lemma-separably-closed-irreducible), 038H (lemma-separably-closed-field-irreducible-components), and 04KS (lemma-generic-points-geometrically-reduced). The residue-field input is the monic-polynomial lifting argument over the normal valuation ring (Algebra Tag 00IC, lemma-valuation-ring-normal), described in report.md; it is not asserted to be the statement of Tag 020J.

proof.text: Put $S=\operatorname{Spec}V$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-domain-stalks-function-field], $S$ is integral, has function field $K$, and its stalk at a prime $\mathfrak q$ is $V_{\mathfrak q}$. Regard $V_{\mathfrak q}$ as a subring of $K$. It contains $V$, has the same fraction field $K$, and for every nonzero $a\in K$, either $a$ or $a^{-1}$ already lies in $V$, hence in $V_{\mathfrak q}$. Thus each $V_{\mathfrak q}$ is a valuation ring. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-valuation-ring-normal] to each one: every stalk of $S$ is a normal domain. This proves exactly the normality needed below, without a height or Noetherian assumption.

source.place: Tag 00IC, lemma-valuation-ring-normal; schemes.tex Tag 01HV, lemma-spec-sheaves; properties.tex Tag 01ON, lemma-characterize-integral; morphisms.tex Tag 01RW, definition-function-field

proof.text: Apply clause (2) of [sbc-lem-etale-over-normal] to the integral normal scheme $S$ of Step 1, whose function field $K$ is separably closed. Every $V_{\mathfrak p}$ is strictly henselian, hence its residue field is separably closed by [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology]. Its residue field is $V_{\mathfrak p}/\mathfrak pV_{\mathfrak p}=\operatorname{Frac}(V/\mathfrak p)$: reduction sends $a/s$ to $\bar a/\bar s$ for $s\notin\mathfrak p$, and every nonzero element of $V/\mathfrak p$ is the image of such a denominator. This proves the first assertion for every prime, including $\mathfrak p=(0)$.

Fix the stated $k$, $Z$, and an irreducible component $C$ with its reduced induced structure. By [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme], $i:C\hookrightarrow Z$ is a closed immersion and $C$ is reduced. Apply [lem-sbc-subset-geometric-irreducibility] to $X=Z$, $A=|C|$, and the separably closed extension $\Omega=k$ with its identity map. The inverse image at this extension is $|C|$ itself, irreducible and nonempty. Hence its inverse image in $Z_L$ is irreducible and nonempty for every $L/k$. It is exactly $|C_L|$: [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change] gives a closed immersion $C_L\hookrightarrow Z_L$, and on an affine chart its image is $V(I(A\otimes_k L))$, since $(A/I)\otimes_kL=(A\otimes_kL)/I(A\otimes_kL)$ by the tensor-product universal property. This is the inverse image of $V(I)$. The affine fibre-product description is [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra]. Thus every $C_L$ is irreducible.

source.place: Tag 020J, lemma-separably-closed-irreducible; Tag 038I, subset formulation; affine closed-subscheme calculation

proof.text: Choose an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $Z$ meeting $C$. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-irreducible-closed-subsets-primes], $C\cap U=V(\mathfrak q)$ for a prime $\mathfrak q$. This prime is minimal: an irreducible closed subset of $U$ strictly containing $C\cap U$ would have irreducible closure in $Z$ containing $C$, contradicting its maximality. Here the closure of $C\cap U$ is $C$, since a nonempty open of an irreducible space is dense. The point $\xi$ corresponding to $\mathfrak q$ is therefore the generic point of $C$. The reduced induced structure gives $C\cap U=\operatorname{Spec}(A/\mathfrak q)$ by [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. The scheme $Z$ is reduced by the hypothesis with $L=k$, so $A$ is reduced by [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. By [lem-weil-pbc-minimal-prime-reduced-localization-field], $A_{\mathfrak q}$ is a field and $\mathfrak q A_{\mathfrak q}=0$. Consequently the stalk maps identify $\mathcal O_{C,\xi}=(A/\mathfrak q)_{\mathfrak q/\mathfrak q}=A_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q A_{\mathfrak q}=A_{\mathfrak q}=\mathcal O_{Z,\xi}$; the affine stalk identifications, including their scalar maps, are [lem-weil-pbc-affine-open-stalk-localization].

source.place: Tag 04KS, lemma-generic-points-geometrically-reduced; generic local ring of a reduced component; algebra.tex Tag 00EU, lemma-minimal-prime-reduced-ring

proof.text: Let $L/k$ be any field extension and use the chart and minimal prime of Step 4. By [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-base-change], $U_L$ is an open subscheme of the reduced scheme $Z_L$, and [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] identifies it with $\operatorname{Spec}(A\otimes_k L)$. Hence $A\otimes_kL$ is reduced by [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-localization-tensor-over-base] with base ring $k$, algebra and module $A$, multiplicative subset $T=A\setminus\mathfrak q$, and $N=L$. It identifies $A_{\mathfrak q}\otimes_kL$ with $T^{-1}(A\otimes_kL)$ as rings: its displayed map sends $(a\otimes l)/t$ to $(a/t)\otimes l$ and preserves products and units on generators. This localization is reduced. Indeed, if $(b/t)^d=0$, some denominator $s$ satisfies $sb^d=0$; then $(sb)^d=0$, so $sb=0$ in the reduced ring, and $b/t=0$. Step 4 now gives that $\mathcal O_{C,\xi}\otimes_kL$ is reduced for every $L/k$.

source.place: Tag 04KS, lemma-generic-points-geometrically-reduced, and Tag 035W, lemma-geometrically-reduced-at-point; localization calculation expanded

proof.text: The reduced scheme $C$ is irreducible and has the single generic point $\xi$ of Step 4. Step 5 verifies the generic-local-ring hypothesis of [lem-pur-geometric-reducedness-from-generic-stalks] for $X=C$, so $C_L$ is reduced for every field extension $L/k$. Step 3 makes the same scheme irreducible and nonempty. Thus $C_L$ is integral by [def-pc-integral-scheme]. This proves the entire geometric-integrality assertion, with no properness, smoothness, or perfection assumption on $k$.

Put $\Omega=\overline k$. For every field extension $E/k$, [lem-weil-pbc-field-tensor-irreducible] gives irreducibility of $\operatorname{Spec}(\Omega\otimes_kE)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-product-affine-spectra] this is $(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)_E$, so $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ is geometrically irreducible. Apply [lem-sc-product-irreducible-components-bijection] with $U=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ and $V=Z$. Thus the projection $Z_\Omega\to Z$ induces a bijection on irreducible components. If $D$ is the component corresponding to $C$, its image is contained in $C$, so $D\subseteq |C_\Omega|$, using the inverse-image description in Step 3. The latter is irreducible by Step 3; maximality of the component $D$ forces $D=|C_\Omega|$. Hence the inverse bijection is precisely $C\mapsto C_\Omega$. By Step 6, $C_\Omega$ is reduced, and its immersion into $Z_\Omega$ is closed by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. The uniqueness clause of [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme] therefore identifies it with the reduced induced structure on that component. This includes the empty scheme, when both component sets are empty.
